problem: 模型页保存无响应：全局dashboard summary同步全量证据扫描阻塞ASGI事件循环；表单缺少成功/失败反馈。

root_cause.confirmed_code_path: App global 5s summary → async dashboard.summary → synchronous DashboardService.summary → EvidenceIndex.refresh → full artifacts recursive scan and parse on event loop
root_cause.runtime_support: backend main thread95.2% CPU and open historical artifact FD while model GETs time out
root_cause.limits: No stack sample; not attributing to Ollama, credential validity, or SQLite.

allowed_files: focused new tests adjacent to existing dashboard/model page tests
this round evidence and stage summary
conditional_files: src/cloud_edge_robot_arm/dashboard/service.py only if minimal service initialization/snapshot coordination requires it
excluded: No deletion, pruning, or modification of historical evidence/artifacts
No changes to DB, keys, unrelated processes, controller or hardware

steps.action: Recheck input hashes, running PID/cwd and current scoped git diff. Record any intended pre-implementation differences. Use existing managed test runtime; no secret inspection.
steps.acceptance: Scope and evidence still apply; unexpected root cause or broader repair goes back to Astra.

steps.action: Add controlled ASGI concurrency regression: hold EvidenceIndex scan via thread Event, issue summary, then profile GET and profile POST with fake non-sensitive fixture in temporary DB; both must finish before releasing scan. Prepatch RED expected. Add scan single-flight/snapshot correctness tests.
steps.acceptance: Single ASGI event loop shared by concurrent requests; timeout cannot hang test cleanup; fake secrets never used against external provider.

steps.action: Offload dashboard routes that actually call refresh/get_detail/runtime(summary) to worker execution (sync FastAPI route or awaited run_in_threadpool), preserving auth and response contracts. Include summary, runtime, evidence, evidence-errors, evidence-detail, evidence-download, evidence-compare. Keep other routes unchanged. Avoid concurrent lazy service initialization producing separate index instances.
steps.acceptance: Blocked evidence scan no longer blocks independent model profile routes or /health.

steps.action: Make EvidenceIndex refresh non-reentrant and publish completed records/errors consistently. Concurrent callers share the same in-flight scan result; no implicit TTL or stale cache. Use minimal lock/condition plus generation/snapshot. Preserve file inclusion, ordering, redaction, path/size safety; a later explicit refresh must discover newly added fixture files.
steps.acceptance: One active scan per index; no cleared/partially mixed result escapes; error and record snapshot consistent; scan failures wake waiters and do not poison subsequent refresh.

steps.action: Add only minimal save success/failure/pending feedback to existing form with safe fixed/localized messages; catch mutateAsync rejection. Preserve all inputs on failure; clear API key field only after confirmed success. Include accurate session-only key lifetime notice. No key editor or unrelated UI state redesign.
steps.acceptance: Successful save is visible; server error/timeout state is understandable and does not leak raw request/secret. Existing create-and-test workflow remains usable.

steps.action: Run focused dashboard/model backend tests and relevant frontend tests/typecheck/build. Review exact diff. Preserve expected RED and GREEN outputs.
steps.acceptance: Behavioral concurrency regression and existing evidence security/contracts pass; frontend validation passes.

steps.action: Capture original backend invocation/cwd and required environment in memory without printing secrets; controlled restart only the identified backend after tests. Do not write secret environment snapshots. Record that InMemorySecretStore loses keys across restart; existing DB secret_present alone is not proof of current key availability. User can create a fresh profile with the existing form.
steps.acceptance: Backend serves same DB/config/address; frontend/unrelated processes untouched; historical evidence and DB preserved.

steps.action: With real large artifact root and /models page open, verify /health and profiles GET remain responsive while summary scans. Save a uniquely named RULE_BASED temporary profile without api_key, verify returned profile ID, then delete exactly that non-active ID. Inspect browser save feedback. Actual key remains for user private input. Record observed results; commit/push only verified explicit paths and compare local/upstream/remote SHA.
steps.acceptance: Real profile read/save responds promptly (target <2s, evidence scanner may still be slow); UI feedback verified; external model authentication is separately observed or explicitly unverified.

runtime_preconditions: Existing Python venv and Node dashboard dependencies available; test DB/artifact fixtures isolated from running DB.
Only identified backend may restart after validation; SESSION_ONLY credentials must be re-entered by user if needed.
Do not capture browser/API request bodies containing real API key.
Original real artifact root remains untouched and available for live concurrency check.
Use .venv/bin/python (pytest/httpx available) and cache/node-v22.23.3-linux-x64/bin/node; system Node18 is not suitable.

acceptance_boundaries.development: Deterministic event-loop nonblocking, single-flight and existing backend/frontend checks pass.
acceptance_boundaries.real_runtime: Actual page plus large artifact root permits profile save/read with visible success/error; live key test only if user has supplied key privately.
acceptance_boundaries.formal_research: No formal research, robotics, real-controller or hardware acceptance claimed.
acceptance_boundaries.out_of_scope: Provider HTTP401 is a valid failed test result, not evidence that save failed; key validity and permanent credential storage are not guaranteed.
